100.description: indicates that the initial part of a request has been received and has not yet been rejected by the server.

101.description: indicates that the server understands and is willing to comply with the client's request, via the Upgrade header field, for a change in the application protocol being used on this connection.

translations.es_es: Se aceptó el cambio de protocolo.
translations.fr_fr: Le changement de protocole est accepté.
translations.it_it: Il cambio di protocollo è stato accettato.

102.description: is an interim response used to inform the client that the server has accepted the complete request, but has not yet completed it.

translations.fr_fr: La requête est en cours de traitement.

103.description: The server sends preliminary response headers before its final response.

translations.fr_fr: Des en-têtes préliminaires ont été envoyés.

200.description: indicates that the request has succeeded.

201.description: indicates that the request has been fulfilled and has resulted in one or more new resources being created.

202.description: indicates that the request has been accepted for processing, but the processing has not been completed.

translations.cz_cs: Požadavek byl přijat, ale ještě nebyl zpracován.
translations.de_de: Anfrage angenommen, Verarbeitung steht noch aus.
translations.dk_da: Anmodningen er accepteret, men ikke færdigbehandlet.
translations.es_es: Se aceptó la solicitud, pero aún no se procesó.
translations.fi_fi: Pyyntö hyväksyttiin, mutta sitä ei ole vielä käsitelty.
translations.fr_fr: La requête est acceptée, mais pas encore traitée.
translations.it_it: La richiesta è accettata ma non ancora elaborata.
translations.nl_nl: Het verzoek is aanvaard maar nog niet verwerkt.
translations.no_no: Forespørselen er godtatt, men ikke ferdigbehandlet.
translations.pl_pl: Żądanie przyjęto, ale nie zostało jeszcze przetworzone.
translations.ru_ru: Запрос принят, но ещё не обработан.
translations.se_sv: Begäran har godkänts men inte behandlats klart.
translations.ua_uk: Запит прийнято, але ще не оброблено.

203.description: indicates that the request was successful but the enclosed payload has been modified from that of the origin server's 200 (OK) response by a transforming proxy.

translations.fi_fi: Onnistunut vastaus, jonka tietoja on muokattu.
translations.fr_fr: Réponse réussie avec des informations modifiées.

204.description: indicates that the server has successfully fulfilled the request and that there is no additional content to send in the response payload body.

translations.cz_cs: Požadavek byl úspěšný bez obsahu odpovědi.
translations.es_es: Solicitud correcta sin contenido de respuesta.
translations.fr_fr: La requête a réussi sans contenu de réponse.
translations.it_it: Richiesta riuscita senza contenuto nella risposta.
translations.nl_nl: Het verzoek is geslaagd zonder antwoordinhoud.
translations.pl_pl: Żądanie zakończyło się powodzeniem bez treści odpowiedzi.

205.description: indicates that the server has fulfilled the request and desires that the user agent reset the document view, which caused the request to be sent, to its original state as received from the origin server.

translations.cz_cs: Zobrazení se má obnovit do výchozího stavu.

206.description: indicates that the server is successfully fulfilling a range request for the target resource by transferring one or more parts of the selected representation that correspond to the satisfiable ranges found in the requests's Range header field.

translations.de_de: Ein Teil des Inhalts wird geliefert.
translations.fr_fr: Une partie du contenu est envoyée.
translations.it_it: Viene inviato solo parte del contenuto.
translations.nl_nl: Een deel van de inhoud wordt geleverd.

207.description: provides status for multiple independent operations.

208.description: The members of a WebDAV binding have already been reported in this response.

translations.es_es: El recurso ya se ha notificado.
translations.fr_fr: La ressource a déjà été signalée.
translations.it_it: La risorsa è già stata segnalata.

226.description: The server has fulfilled a GET request for the resource, and the response is a representation of the result of one or more instance-manipulations applied to the current instance.

translations.fr_fr: Un encodage différentiel a été utilisé.
translations.it_it: È stata usata una codifica differenziale.

300.description: indicates that the target resource has more than one representation, each with its own more specific identifier, and information about the alternatives is being provided so that the user (or user agent) can select a preferred representation by redirecting its request to one or more of those identifiers.

translations.se_sv: Flera representationer finns att välja mellan.

301.description: indicates that the target resource has been assigned a new permanent URI and any future references to this resource ought to use one of the enclosed URIs.

translations.es_es: El recurso se trasladó de forma permanente.
translations.fr_fr: La ressource a été déplacée définitivement.
translations.it_it: La risorsa è stata spostata definitivamente.

302.description: indicates that the target resource resides temporarily under a different URI.

translations.dk_da: Ressourcen findes midlertidigt et andet sted.
translations.es_es: El recurso está temporalmente en otra ubicación.
translations.fr_fr: La ressource se trouve temporairement ailleurs.
translations.it_it: La risorsa si trova temporaneamente altrove.
translations.nl_nl: De bron bevindt zich tijdelijk elders.
translations.no_no: Ressursen finnes midlertidig et annet sted.
translations.pl_pl: Zasób znajduje się tymczasowo gdzie indziej.
translations.ru_ru: Ресурс временно находится по другому адресу.
translations.ua_uk: Ресурс тимчасово доступний за іншою адресою.

303.description: indicates that the server is redirecting the user agent to a different resource, as indicated by a URI in the Location header field, that is intended to provide an indirect response to the original request.

translations.cz_cs: Odpověď je dostupná na jiné adrese.
translations.de_de: Antwort ist unter einer anderen Adresse verfügbar.
translations.dk_da: Svaret findes på en anden adresse.
translations.es_es: La respuesta está en otra dirección.
translations.fr_fr: La réponse se trouve à une autre adresse.
translations.it_it: La risposta si trova a un altro indirizzo.
translations.nl_nl: Het antwoord staat op een ander adres.
translations.no_no: Svaret finnes på en annen adresse.
translations.pl_pl: Odpowiedź jest dostępna pod innym adresem.
translations.se_sv: Svaret finns på en annan adress.

304.description: indicates that a conditional GET request has been received and would have resulted in a 200 (OK) response if it were not for the fact that the condition has evaluated to false.

translations.es_es: El recurso no se ha modificado.
translations.fr_fr: La ressource n'a pas été modifiée.
translations.it_it: La risorsa non è stata modificata.

305.description: Deprecated. This status was once used to direct the client to a proxy.

translations.es_es: El uso de proxy está obsoleto.
translations.it_it: L'uso di un proxy è deprecato.
translations.nl_nl: Het gebruik van een proxy is verouderd.

307.description: indicates that the target resource resides temporarily under a different URI and the user agent MUST NOT change the request method if it performs an automatic redirection to that URI.

308.description: The target resource has been assigned a new permanent URI and any future references to this resource outght to use one of the enclosed URIs. [...] This status code is similar to 301 Moved Permanently (Section 7.3.2 of rfc7231), except that it does not allow rewriting the request method from POST to GET.

400.description: indicates that the server cannot or will not process the request because the received syntax is invalid, nonsensical, or exceeds some limitation on what the server is willing to process.

401.description: indicates that the request has not been applied because it lacks valid authentication credentials for the target resource.

403.description: indicates that the server understood the request but refuses to authorize it.

404.description: indicates that the origin server did not find a current representation for the target resource or is not willing to disclose that one exists.

405.description: indicates that the method specified in the request-line is known by the origin server but not supported by the target resource.

406.description: indicates that the target resource does not have a current representation that would be acceptable to the user agent, according to the proactive negotiation header fields received in the request, and the server is unwilling to supply a default representation.

407.description: is similar to 401 (Unauthorized), but indicates that the client needs to authenticate itself in order to use a proxy.

408.description: indicates that the server did not receive a complete request message within the time that it was prepared to wait.

translations.es_es: Se agotó el tiempo de la solicitud.

409.description: indicates that the request could not be completed due to a conflict with the current state of the resource.

410.description: indicates that access to the target resource is no longer available at the origin server and that this condition is likely to be permanent.

translations.es_es: El recurso ya no está disponible.
translations.it_it: La risorsa non è più disponibile.
translations.nl_nl: De bron is niet meer beschikbaar.

411.description: indicates that the server refuses to accept the request without a defined Content-Length.

translations.es_es: Se requiere la longitud del contenido.
translations.it_it: È richiesta la lunghezza del contenuto.

412.description: indicates that one or more preconditions given in the request header fields evaluated to false when tested on the server.

translations.es_es: No se cumplió la condición previa.

413.description: The request content is larger than the server is willing or able to process.

translations.es_es: El contenido de la solicitud es demasiado grande.
translations.fr_fr: Le contenu de la requête est trop volumineux.
translations.it_it: Il contenuto della richiesta è troppo grande.
translations.nl_nl: De inhoud van het verzoek is te groot.
translations.no_no: Innholdet i forespørselen er for stort.

414.description: indicates that the server is refusing to service the request because the request-target is longer than the server is willing to interpret.

415.description: indicates that the origin server is refusing to service the request because the payload is in a format not supported by the target resource for this method.

translations.fr_fr: Type de média non pris en charge.

416.description: indicates that none of the ranges in the request's Range header field overlap the current extent of the selected resource or that the set of ranges requested has been rejected due to invalid ranges or an excessive request of small or overlapping ranges.

translations.dk_da: Det ønskede område er ikke tilgængeligt.
translations.es_es: El intervalo solicitado no está disponible.
translations.fr_fr: La plage demandée n'est pas disponible.
translations.nl_nl: Het gevraagde bereik is niet beschikbaar.
translations.no_no: Det forespurte området er ikke tilgjengelig.
translations.se_sv: Det begärda intervallet är inte tillgängligt.

417.description: indicates that the expectation given in the request's Expect header field could not be met by at least one of the inbound servers.

translations.es_es: No se pudo cumplir la expectativa.
translations.fr_fr: L'attente ne peut pas être satisfaite.
translations.nl_nl: De verwachting kon niet worden vervuld.

421.description: The request reached a server that cannot provide an authoritative response for the target URI.

translations.cz_cs: Požadavek byl odeslán na nesprávný server.
translations.de_de: Anfrage an den falschen Server gerichtet.
translations.dk_da: Anmodningen blev sendt til den forkerte server.
translations.es_es: La solicitud llegó al servidor equivocado.
translations.fr_fr: La requête a été dirigée vers le mauvais serveur.
translations.it_it: La richiesta è stata inviata al server sbagliato.
translations.nl_nl: Het verzoek is naar de verkeerde server gestuurd.
translations.no_no: Forespørselen ble sendt til feil server.
translations.ua_uk: Запит спрямовано не на той сервер.

422.description: The request content is syntactically correct but its instructions cannot be processed.

translations.es_es: No se puede procesar el contenido.
translations.fr_fr: Le contenu ne peut pas être traité.
translations.it_it: Il contenuto non può essere elaborato.
translations.nl_nl: De inhoud kan niet worden verwerkt.

423.description: means the source or destination resource of a method is locked.

424.description: means that the method could not be performed on the resource because the requested action depended on another action and that action failed.

translations.es_es: Falló una operación de la que se depende.

425.description: The server declines to process a request that might be replayed.

translations.cz_cs: Požadavek přišel příliš brzy na bezpečné zpracování.
translations.de_de: Anfrage kommt für sichere Verarbeitung zu früh.
translations.dk_da: Anmodningen kom for tidligt til sikker behandling.
translations.es_es: La solicitud llegó demasiado pronto para procesarla con seguridad.
translations.fi_fi: Pyyntö saapui liian aikaisin turvallista käsittelyä varten.
translations.fr_fr: La requête est arrivée trop tôt pour être traitée sûrement.
translations.it_it: La richiesta è arrivata troppo presto per un'elaborazione sicura.
translations.lt_lt: Užklausa gauta per anksti saugiam apdorojimui.
translations.nl_nl: Het verzoek kwam te vroeg voor veilige verwerking.
translations.no_no: Forespørselen kom for tidlig for sikker behandling.
translations.pl_pl: Żądanie nadeszło zbyt wcześnie, by bezpiecznie je przetworzyć.
translations.ru_ru: Запрос поступил слишком рано для безопасной обработки.
translations.se_sv: Begäran kom för tidigt för säker behandling.
translations.ua_uk: Запит надійшов зарано для безпечної обробки.

426.description: indicates that the server refuses to perform the request using the current protocol but might be willing to do so after the client upgrades to a different protocol.

translations.fr_fr: Une mise à niveau du protocole est requise.
translations.it_it: È richiesto un aggiornamento del protocollo.

428.description: indicates that the origin server requires the request to be conditional.

429.description: indicates that the user has sent too many requests in a given amount of time (rate limiting).

431.description: indicates that the server is unwilling to process the request because its header fields are too large.

translations.es_es: Las cabeceras de la solicitud son demasiado grandes.
translations.fr_fr: Les en-têtes de la requête sont trop volumineux.
translations.it_it: Le intestazioni della richiesta sono troppo grandi.

451.description: This status code indicates that the server is denying access to the resource in response to a legal demand.

500.description: indicates that the server encountered an unexpected condition that prevented it from fulfilling the request.

501.description: indicates that the server does not support the functionality required to fulfill the request.

502.description: indicates that the server, while acting as a gateway or proxy, received an invalid response from an inbound server it accessed while attempting to fulfill the request.

translations.dk_da: Ugyldigt svar fra en overordnet server.
translations.es_es: Respuesta no válida del servidor de origen.
translations.fr_fr: Réponse invalide du serveur en amont.
translations.it_it: Risposta non valida dal server a monte.
translations.nl_nl: Ongeldig antwoord van de bovenliggende server.
translations.no_no: Ugyldig svar fra en oppstrøms server.

503.description: indicates that the server is currently unable to handle the request due to a temporary overload or scheduled maintenance, which will likely be alleviated after some delay.

504.description: indicates that the server, while acting as a gateway or proxy, did not receive a timely response from an upstream server it needed to access in order to complete the request.

translations.es_es: Se agotó el tiempo de la puerta de enlace.
translations.it_it: Tempo di attesa del gateway scaduto.

505.description: indicates that the server does not support, or refuses to support, the protocol version that was used in the request message.

translations.fr_fr: Version HTTP non prise en charge.

506.description: indicates that the server has an internal configuration error: the chosen variant resource is configured to engage in transparent content negotiation itself, and is therefore not a proper end point in the negotiation process.

translations.de_de: Fehler bei der Aushandlung der Inhaltsvariante.
translations.es_es: Error al negociar la variante del contenido.
translations.nl_nl: Fout bij de onderhandeling over de variant.

507.description: means the method could not be performed on the resource because the server is unable to store the representation needed to successfully complete the request.

508.description: The server detected a loop while processing a WebDAV request.

translations.es_es: Se detectó un bucle de procesamiento.

511.description: indicates that the client needs to authenticate to gain network access.
